messages:
maria: heads-up — after rolling driver v540.12 to a 15% cohort in eu-west, we started seeing an uptick in Xid events on a subset of p4d nodes around 02:14 UTC. attaching quick notes.
aj: saw the spike on the telemetry dashboard, looks clustered to machines with fw tag fw1.2.3. ECC single-bit counts also elevated on the same hosts :thinking_face:
devon: how big is the delta vs baseline? any correlate with long sequence lengths or KV cache pressure?
maria: numbers from the 1h window: Xid rate jumped from ~0.08% -> ~0.65% on the cohort. ECC single-bit errors went from ~24->78 across 8 nodes. not yet seeing multi-bit.
li: can we map serials -> host? if it’s a vendor batch we should isolate.
carter: yes, inventory has serial mapping. initial quick filter shows 6 of 8 nodes share vendor batch B-17. I'll export list.
maria: logs snippet:
```text
[2026-02-12T02:14:05Z] GPU0 Xid 31 at 0x7f.. kernel: nvme timeout -> reset
[2026-02-12T02:14:07Z] ECC single-bit corrected: count++
```
aj: temporary action: pause rollout to next cohort and mark fw1.2.3 as suspect. we should run a controlled revert on 3 nodes and validate.
tasha: ops runbook reminder for draining: use `kubectl cordon` then `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` to avoid scheduling churn. example:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-123
kubectl drain gpu-node-123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300
```
maria: propose validation plan:
- rollback driver to v540.8 on 3 repro nodes (eu-west-canary)
- run 12h synthetic burn-in with long-seq + mixed-batch workload
- collect per-serial Xid histogram and ECC counts
- add telemetry alert: Xid% > 0.3% over 1h AND delta > 3x baseline -> paging
- if ECC multi-bit observed or Xid% > 0.4% sustained for 30m -> auto rollback cohort
carter: i'll submit an infra job: `gpu-stress --suite longseq --duration 12h --kv-cache-on` and attach results to the job run. template pushed to infra-jobs.
devon: i'll extend the burn-in harness to include synthetic prompt lengths 512-2048 to exercise larger KV cache. also add a check for driver oops stack traces and correlate with kernel logs.
li: i'll run the revert on eu-west staging now and report telemetry in ~2h. also will tag nodes from batch B-17 as quiesced.
aj: update gating: new rollout gating rule: canary cohort must pass 24h burn-in with Xid rate <0.1% and no ECC multi-bit. i'll own rollout gating changes in the console.
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-1293 created for driver/firmware validation. severity: low, assignees: aj, devon, li. links: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-1293
maria: one more: please add a dashboard tile that overlays rollout cohort (by fw version) on the Xid heatmap and per-serial histograms — will make triage faster :thumbsup:
aj: ack — will add tile and update alert thresholds. devon, once your harness runs, drop the job id here and i'll tie the job artifact to the incident.
carter: also recommend we add a lightweight host-level probe that emits `gpu.selftest` metric after driver load; if probe fails, we don't include host in rollout cohort.
maria: thanks team. if anyone hits unexpected multi-bit ECC or kernel oops, escalate to P0 and we'll initiate mass rollback. otherwise follow the revert+burn-in plan and update incident with burn-in artifacts. ping me on thread for any manual overrides.
_meta: generated for dataset: slack thread about driver/firmware validation and GPU Xid/ECC triage
